statement: Solve the equation $\sin2x=\cos x$ for $0\le x<2\pi$.
solution: $\sin2x=2\sin x\cos x$, so the equation is $2\sin x\cos x=\cos x$, i.e. $\cos x(2\sin x-1)=0$. Either $\cos x=0$ giving $x=\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{3\pi}{2}$, or $\sin x=\tfrac12$ giving $x=\frac{\pi}{6},\frac{5\pi}{6}$. The solutions are $x=\frac{\pi}{6},\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{5\pi}{6},\frac{3\pi}{2}$.
hints: Bring everything to one side and factor cos x.
